text: このひとは　あたしが　ついてなきゃ　だめだって　おもったの

structure.jp: あたしが　ついてなきゃ　だめだって
structure.en: that it's no good unless I'm with him

patterns.name: 〜なければならない
patterns.span: ついてなきゃ　だめだ
patterns.explanation: なきゃ is short for なければ, 'if not', and with だめだ it says 'it's no good unless'. ついてなきゃ　だめだ = 'it's no good unless I'm with him'.

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: って is the casual form of と and works like quote signs around what is said or thought. だめだって　おもった = 'I thought "it's no good"'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end of a statement is the soft, feminine form of のだ and gives the sentence an explaining tone. おもったの = 'you see, I thought so'.
